prov_test_1.text: How do I change my job categories and what is your website?

Hi Tatenda! To update your job categories, simply open the *side menu (☰)* or your *provider header* in the app and select *Account Settings*. You can manage up to 3 categories there at any time. Our official website is *https://finditharare.co.zw*. Let me know if you need help with anything else!
